## Shells and variables
1. Use (a) the CLI and (b) a script to demonstrate that global variables can be set in the parent shell.
1. Show that global variables set in a subshell are not accessible in the parent shell.
1. Demonstrate that non-global variables are shell-specific.
1. Send these examples to your instructor.
